svg.title: Agarobiose, the repeating unit of agar
svg.desc: Skeletal formula of agarobiose: a galactose ring linked to a 3,6-anhydro-galactose ring, which has an internal oxygen bridge.
svg.text: Agarobiose: the repeating unit of agar
Right: β-D-galactose. Left: 3,6-anhydro-α-L-galactose, whose ring is bridged by an extra oxygen.
